groups.activity: Dark Sector Disruption; kill every Demolisher
conditions: The blueprint is a floor drop from each Demolisher corpse, not an end-of-round reward. Use Vacuum or Fetch, and ask a squad to mark drops.
Each of four Demolishers per full round rolls independently. Protecting every conduit means four chances.
a duplicate only sells for credits.
bonuses: Akarius shares the same 2.5% Demolisher table, and deeper runs also make a solid Neo/Axi relic farm.

disclosures.title: reset before the mission gets ugly
disclosures.body: For a dedicated Acceltra farm, do one to a few rounds, extract, and re-queue. Your per-Demolisher odds never improve with depth, while enemy level does. Stay deep only when you also want the rotation-C relic rewards.

disclosures.title: Demolisher survival
disclosures.body: At Ur, Demolishers are immune to Viral. Bring raw weapon damage with Heat or Slash; Cold slows them. Their nullifier pulse strips nearby buffs, so attack in the window after it fires.

rows.label: Acceltra
